item.title: Cute Frog with Mushroom Umbrella Frogcore Art
item.description: A round little frog holds a red-capped mushroom over its head like a tiny umbrella, ready for a rainy day in the woods. Frog lovers and cottagecore fans will love it, and it makes a charming, funny gift. Find it on stickers, tote bags and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Cute Mushroom Sprite with Acorn Basket Goblincore
item.description: A tiny mushroom sprite sits contentedly with a woven basket of acorns after a good day of foraging. A charming gift for goblincore fans, mushroom hunters and woodland dreamers. Find it on stickers, tote bags and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Chubby Frog with Tiny Mushroom Treasure Frogcore
item.description: A chubby green frog sits cross-legged, clutching a tiny red mushroom like priceless forest treasure. A sweet, funny gift for frog fans, mushroom foragers and cottagecore dreamers. Find it on stickers, mugs and tote bags. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Spooky Mushroom Sprite Grows Best in the Dark
item.description: A tiny mushroom sprite with bat wings smiles beside the line Grows best in the dark, a cozy nod to shade-loving fungi and night owls. A funny gift for introverts and goth cottagecore fans on stickers, hoodies and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Sleepy Witch Frog Cursed but in a Cozy Way
item.description: A sleepy little frog in a witch hat smiles through its hex, proving you can be cursed and still totally cozy. Perfect for frog lovers and cottagecore witches, it makes a funny gift on stickers, sweatshirts and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Witch Frog Wearing a Tall Pointed Hat
item.description: A chubby little frog in a tall pointed witch hat, smiling like it just brewed the perfect potion. A sweet, spooky pick for frog lovers and anyone who likes witchy things. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.
